response.sql: WITH acct_avg AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount FROM account a JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_avg AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_amount) AS figure FROM acct_avg GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(figure) AS overall_avg FROM region_avg) SELECT r.region, r.figure, r.figure - o.overall_avg AS exceeds_overall_avg, r.figure / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_overall_avg FROM region_avg r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE r.figure > o.overall_avg;
